title.zh: 卷157 志一百三十二 邦交五 德意志
title.raw: 卷157 志一百三十二 邦交五 德意志

sentences.zh: 德意志者，日爾曼列國總部名也，舊名邪馬尼，居歐洲中原，同盟三十六國，而中惟布路斯最強。

translations.literal: Deutschland is the collective name of the Germanic states; its old name was Germania; it lies in central Europe; thirty-six states are in confederation, and among them Prussia alone is strongest.
translations.idiomatic: Germany is the collective designation of the German states; it was once called Germania, lies in central Europe, and comprises thirty-six states in confederation, of which Prussia is the strongest.

sentences.zh: 三年春三月，布國遣使臣李福斯來京，欲見總署王大臣呈遞國書。

translations.literal: In the spring of the third year, the third month, Prussia sent the envoy Li Fusi to the capital, wishing to see the prince ministers of the Foreign Office to present a state letter.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of spring in the third year, Prussia sent Envoy Li Fusi to Beijing to present credentials to the chief ministers of the Zongli Yamen.

sentences.zh: 三口通商大臣崇厚以聞，並稱布國坐來兵船，在大沽攔江沙外扣留丹國商船三艘。

translations.literal: The Taku trade commissioner Chonghou reported this, and also stated that Prussian warships which had come were holding three Danish merchant ships outside the Dagu sandbar at the river mouth.
translations.idiomatic: Taku trade commissioner Chonghou reported the visit and added that Prussian warships at Dagu had detained three Danish merchant vessels beyond the river sandbar.

sentences.zh: 總署以布使不應在中國洋面扣留敵船，詰之。

translations.literal: The Foreign Office, on the grounds that the Prussian envoy ought not detain enemy ships on Chinese waters, questioned him.
translations.idiomatic: The Zongli Yamen rebuked the Prussian envoy for detaining enemy vessels in Chinese waters.

sentences.zh: 李福斯接牒，即將丹船放回二艘，並遣譯官謝罪，總署始允會晤。

translations.literal: Li Fusi received the note, immediately released two Danish ships, and sent an interpreter to apologize; only then did the Foreign Office agree to a meeting.
translations.idiomatic: Li Fusi received the dispatch, released two of the Danish ships, and sent an interpreter to apologize, after which the Yamen agreed to receive him.

sentences.zh: 七年夏四月，布路斯君主維利恩復以李福斯為秉權大臣，來華呈遞國書。

translations.literal: In the summer of the seventh year, the fourth month, the Prussian sovereign William again appointed Li Fusi plenipotentiary minister and sent him to China to present a state letter.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer in the seventh year, King William of Prussia again sent Li Fusi as plenipotentiary minister to present credentials in China.

sentences.zh: 八年，咸伯國商人美利士私在臺灣大南澳境伐木墾荒，閩浙總督以聞。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, the Hamburg merchant Mellish privately felled timber and opened land in the Tainan-ao region of Taiwan; the Fujian-Zhejiang governor-general reported this.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, Hamburg merchant Mellish was reported to have illegally logged and reclaimed land at Danan'ao in Taiwan.

sentences.zh: 總署以美利士違約妄為，牒布使詰問，請其查辦。

translations.literal: The Foreign Office, on the grounds that Mellish had acted in violation of treaty and without authorization, sent a note to the Prussian envoy to question him and request an investigation.
translations.idiomatic: The Yamen noted Mellish's breach of treaty and unauthorized conduct, and asked the Prussian envoy to investigate.

sentences.zh: 十年春，李福斯遞國書，言德意志各國共推戴布國君主為德意志國大皇帝，中國覆書致賀。

translations.literal: In the spring of the tenth year, Li Fusi presented a state letter stating that the German states had jointly elevated the Prussian sovereign to German Emperor; China sent a congratulatory reply.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the tenth year, Li Fusi announced that the German states had proclaimed the Prussian king German Emperor; Beijing sent congratulations in reply.

sentences.zh: 是年李福斯回國，以領事安訥克為署使。

translations.literal: That year Li Fusi returned home, and Consul Annecke was left as acting envoy.
translations.idiomatic: That year Li Fusi went home and Consul Annecke served as acting minister.

sentences.zh: 十一年，安訥克以條約十年期滿，牒中國請換約，未果。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, Annecke, on the grounds that the ten-year treaty term had expired, sent a note to China requesting renewal; it was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, Annecke asked to renew the treaty on its ten-year expiry, but China did not agree.

sentences.zh: 李福斯復來，十二月，復遞國書。

translations.literal: Li Fusi came again; in the twelfth month he again presented a state letter.
translations.idiomatic: Li Fusi returned and in the twelfth month presented credentials again.

sentences.zh: 明年正月，穆宗親政，請覲見，許之。

translations.literal: In the first month of the following year, Emperor Muzong took personal rule; Li Fusi requested an audience and was permitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the following year, after the Tongzhi Emperor began personal rule, Li Fusi was granted an audience.

sentences.zh: 屆時李福斯因病回國，署使和立本特備文慶賀，因聲明將來本國使臣朝覲，應按此次所定節略辦理，許之。

translations.literal: When the time came, Li Fusi returned home due to illness; Acting Envoy Holleben prepared documents of congratulation and declared that future envoys from his country seeking audience should follow the protocol settled on this occasion; this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Li Fusi left for illness; Acting Envoy Holleben offered congratulations and secured agreement that future German ministers would follow the audience protocol fixed on this occasion.

sentences.zh: 九月，德國安訥船在福建洋面遭水賊殺斃船主、大夥，並毀其船，閩撫丁日昌當將犯拏獲斬梟，並追贓一萬三千餘元。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, the German ship Annecke on Fujian waters was attacked by pirates who killed the master and crew and destroyed the vessel; Fujian governor Ding Richang promptly captured and executed the culprits and recovered more than thirteen thousand yuan in stolen goods.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, pirates off Fujian killed the master and crew of the German ship Annecke and scuttled her; Governor Ding Richang executed the offenders and recovered over thirteen thousand yuan in loot.

sentences.zh: 德使責中國賠償，總署以德約三十三款明言不能賠償贓物，不許。

translations.literal: The German envoy demanded compensation from China; the Foreign Office, citing Article 33 of the German treaty which clearly states that stolen goods cannot be compensated, refused.
translations.idiomatic: The German minister demanded indemnity, but the Yamen refused, citing the treaty clause that China is not liable for stolen property.

sentences.zh: 二年，德以巴蘭德為駐華公使。

translations.literal: In the second year, Germany appointed Brandt resident minister to China.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, Germany appointed Brandt minister to China.

sentences.zh: 春三月，直隸總督李鴻章始遣遊擊卞長勝等五弁，赴德武學院學習陸軍槍砲操法。

translations.literal: In the spring, the third month, Zhili governor-general Li Hongzhang first sent the battalion commander Bian Changsheng and four other officers to the German military academy to study army rifle and artillery drill.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of spring, Li Hongzhang sent Bian Changsheng and four other officers to Germany to train in infantry and artillery drill.

sentences.zh: 巴蘭德牒總督，催請換約。

translations.literal: Brandt sent a note to the governor-general urging renewal of the treaty.
translations.idiomatic: Brandt pressed the governor-general to renew the treaty.

sentences.zh: 十月，巴蘭德復牒總署索三事：一，洋商在租界內售賣洋貨，不再抽釐金；

translations.literal: In the tenth month, Brandt again sent a note to the Foreign Office demanding three things: first, that foreign merchants selling foreign goods within the concessions no longer pay likin duties;
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, Brandt asked the Yamen for three concessions: first, exemption from likin on foreign goods sold in the concessions;

sentences.zh: 二，發給存票，不立期限，並准其以存票支取現銀；

translations.literal: second, that deposit receipts be issued without term limits and that they be allowed to draw silver against such receipts;
translations.idiomatic: second, that deposit receipts be issued without maturity limits and be redeemable for silver;

sentences.zh: 三，德商入內地採買土貨，准攜現銀。

translations.literal: third, that German merchants going inland to purchase native goods be permitted to carry cash silver.
translations.idiomatic: third, that German merchants buying native goods inland be allowed to carry silver cash.

sentences.zh: 又請於年內開辦上海一口；

translations.literal: He also requested that within the year Shanghai be opened as a port;
translations.idiomatic: He also asked that Shanghai be opened as a port within the year;

sentences.zh: 又求在大孤山添開口岸，鄱陽湖拖帶輪船，吳淞口上下貨物三端。

translations.literal: and further sought to add a port at Dagushan, steam towing on Poyang Lake, and loading and unloading of goods at Wusong mouth—three additional points.
translations.idiomatic: and sought three more items: a new port at Dagushan, steam towing on Poyang Lake, and cargo handling at Wusong.

sentences.zh: 總署拒之，屢辯駮，不省。

translations.literal: The Foreign Office refused; after repeated argument and rebuttal, he would not understand.
translations.idiomatic: The Yamen refused repeatedly, but Brandt would not relent.

sentences.zh: 明年五月，遂偕繙譯官阿恩德出京。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the following year, he then left the capital with the interpreter Arnhold.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the following year he left Beijing with interpreter Arnhold.

sentences.zh: 既抵天津，往晤李鴻章，鴻章曉以兩國意見即有不合，應往返商辦，力勸之，巴使乃回京。

translations.literal: After reaching Tianjin, he called on Li Hongzhang; Hongzhang explained that even when the two countries' views differed, matters should be settled by back-and-forth negotiation, and urged him strongly; the German envoy then returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianjin, Li Hongzhang urged Brandt to negotiate in Beijing rather than leave, and Brandt returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 總署促與開議，忽言俟十月間再議。

translations.literal: The Foreign Office urged him to open talks, but he suddenly said he would wait until the tenth month to negotiate again.
translations.idiomatic: The Yamen pressed for talks, but he suddenly deferred negotiation until the tenth month.

sentences.zh: 是年德使館定居東交民巷，仍納租價。

translations.literal: That year the German legation was permanently established in Dongjiaomin Lane, still paying rent.
translations.idiomatic: That year the German legation was fixed in Dongjiaomin Lane, with rent still paid.

sentences.zh: 四年，以光祿寺少卿劉錫鴻為出使德國大臣，並遞國書。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, Vice Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Liu Xihong was appointed envoy to Germany and presented credentials.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, Liu Xihong was appointed envoy to Germany and presented credentials.

sentences.zh: 劉錫鴻尋奏，聞德外務大臣促巴蘭德速立新約，而巴蘭德於吳淞起卸貨物、鄱陽拖帶輪船、內地租住店房三條仍力爭，至是竟回國。

translations.literal: Liu Xihong soon memorialized that he had heard the German foreign minister was urging Brandt to conclude a new treaty quickly, yet Brandt still pressed hard on the three points of Wusong cargo handling, Poyang steam towing, and inland shop leasing; at this point he actually returned home.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Xihong reported that Berlin was pressing Brandt to conclude a treaty, but Brandt still fought for Wusong cargo rights, Poyang towing, and inland shops, then went home.

sentences.zh: 明年閏三月，巴使復來華議約，仍著重前三條。

translations.literal: In the intercalary third month of the following year, the German envoy returned to China to negotiate the treaty, still emphasizing the first three articles.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary third month of the following year, Brandt returned to negotiate and again pressed the same three points.

sentences.zh: 時德丕里約夾板船至山東榮成縣所屬海面觸礁，巴使要求賠償，拒之。

translations.literal: At this time a German brig of the firm De Pereire ran aground on waters off Rongcheng county, Shandong; the German envoy demanded compensation and was refused.
translations.idiomatic: A German brig of De Pereire ran aground off Rongcheng, Shandong; Brandt demanded compensation and was refused.

sentences.zh: 巴使又以天津紫竹林無德國租界，要求在法界以上另添租界，不許。

translations.literal: The German envoy also, on the grounds that there was no German concession at Tianjin's Zizhulin, requested an additional concession above the French quarter; this was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: Brandt also asked for a German concession above the French quarter at Tianjin's Zizhulin and was refused.

sentences.zh: 是年閏五月，以候選道李鳳苞為出使德國大臣。

translations.literal: In the intercalary fifth month of that year, the expectant intendant Li Fengbao was appointed envoy to Germany.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary fifth month of that year, Li Fengbao was appointed envoy to Germany.

sentences.zh: 六年春二月，朝廷因德約議久未成，特派總理各國事務、協辦大學士、兵部尚書沈桂芬，戶部尚書景廉為全權大臣，復與巴使開議。

translations.literal: In the spring of the sixth year, the second month, because German treaty talks had long remained unsettled, the court specially appointed Grand Secretary for Foreign Affairs and Associate Grand Secretary, Minister of War Shen Guifen, and Minister of Revenue Jing Lian as plenipotentiaries to reopen negotiations with the German envoy.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of spring in the sixth year, the court appointed Shen Guifen and Jing Lian plenipotentiaries to reopen treaty talks with Brandt.

sentences.zh: 久之，巴使始允將「大孤山、鄱陽湖及洋商入內地」刪去，並照英國新約辦法，彼此條款略相抵；

translations.literal: After a long time, the German envoy finally agreed to delete the items on Dagushan, Poyang Lake, and foreign merchants entering the interior, and to follow the method of Britain's new treaty, with the two sides' articles roughly balancing each other;
translations.idiomatic: Eventually Brandt dropped Dagushan, Poyang Lake, and inland trade demands and agreed to mirror Britain's recent treaty terms.

sentences.zh: 惟江蘇吳淞口一處，允德船隻暫停泊，上下客商貨物，章程仍由中國江海關道自訂。

translations.literal: only at Wusong mouth in Jiangsu was German shipping temporarily allowed to anchor and load and unload merchant goods, with regulations still to be set by China's maritime customs intendant.
translations.idiomatic: Only at Jiangsu's Wusong were German vessels allowed temporary anchorage for cargo, under regulations set by Chinese customs.

sentences.zh: 遂於二月二十一日畫押，並聲明二事：一，德國夾板在中國口岸停泊十四日以外者，則自第十五日起，即于應交正數船鈔減半，先行試辦；

translations.literal: On the twenty-first day of the second month the treaty was initialed, with two declarations: first, that German brigs staying at Chinese ports beyond fourteen days would from the fifteenth day onward have the regular tonnage dues halved, to be tried first on a trial basis;
translations.idiomatic: On the twenty-first of the second month the treaty was initialed with two side notes: first, tonnage dues for German brigs in port over fourteen days would be halved from the fifteenth day on a trial basis;

sentences.zh: 一，第六款內「德國允，德國人等」條內有「遊歷」二字，德譯與華文不符，應將德文字意更正。

translations.literal: second, in Article 6, the clause "Germany permits Germans and others" contains the two characters "travel"; the German translation did not match the Chinese text and the German wording should be corrected to the proper meaning.
translations.idiomatic: second, the word "travel" in Article 6 did not match the German text and would be corrected in the German version.

sentences.zh: 遂約自畫押之日起，限一年內互換。

translations.literal: It was agreed that exchange would take place within one year from the date of initialing.
translations.idiomatic: Exchange was set for within one year of initialing.

sentences.zh: 已，巴使於六月三十日又來牒，稱德國國法，凡議立條約，必須先問國會，國會允許，方能批准；

translations.literal: Thereafter, on the thirtieth day of the sixth month the German envoy again sent a note, stating that under German national law any treaty must first be submitted to parliament; only after parliament's approval could it be ratified;
translations.idiomatic: On the thirtieth of the sixth month Brandt noted that under German law treaties required parliamentary approval before ratification;

sentences.zh: 本國國會約在明年，所議三月初二日互換約章一款，請將期限改為光緒七年十月初十日。

translations.literal: his country's parliament would meet about the following year; the agreed clause for exchange on the second day of the third month should be changed to the tenth day of the tenth month of the seventh year of Guangxu.
translations.idiomatic: and asked to move exchange from the third month to the tenth day of the tenth month, Guangxu 7.

sentences.zh: 七年秋七月，巴使請定期互換條約，政府命景廉與巴使在北京總署畫押互換，是為中德續約十款，並善後章程九條。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the seventh year, the seventh month, the German envoy requested a fixed date for exchange; the government ordered Jing Lian and the German envoy to initial and exchange at the Beijing Foreign Office; this was the Sino-German supplementary treaty of ten articles, with nine supplementary regulations.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn in the seventh year, Brandt arranged exchange; Jing Lian and Brandt signed at the Yamen—the Sino-German supplementary treaty of ten articles and nine implementing regulations.

sentences.zh: 八年夏六月，德始與朝鮮議約，中國派員蒞盟，聲明為中國屬邦。

translations.literal: In the summer of the eighth year, the sixth month, Germany first negotiated a treaty with Korea; China sent an officer to attend the signing and declared Korea a dependency of China.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of summer in the eighth year, Germany negotiated with Korea; China attended and declared Korea a tributary state.

sentences.zh: 九年冬十月，議結德魯麟洋行地畝案。

translations.literal: In the winter of the ninth year, the tenth month, the case of the Drewsen & Co. firm's land was settled.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter in the ninth year, the Drewsen land dispute was settled.

sentences.zh: 初，廣東汕頭新開附地有海坪官地，中國欲填築作為商埠，忽有德魯麟洋行買辦華民郭繼宗謂系伊地，陰結德駐汕頭領事沙博哈，及德水師兵船，豎旗強佔。

translations.literal: Initially, at the newly opened foreshore of Shantou, Guangdong, there was official tidal land which China wished to reclaim as a commercial port; suddenly the Chinese comprador Guo Jizong of Drewsen & Co. claimed it as his land, secretly colluded with the German consul at Shantou Schabhar and German naval vessels, and forcibly occupied it by raising flags.
translations.idiomatic: At Shantou's new foreshore, China planned to reclaim official tidal land for a port when Drewsen comprador Guo Jizong claimed it as private property, colluded with Consul Schabhar and German warships, and seized it by force.

sentences.zh: 中國聞之，牒向德使詰問，並命出使大臣李鳳苞與德外部辯論。

translations.literal: When China learned of this, it sent a note to the German envoy to question him and ordered Envoy Li Fengbao to argue the matter with the German foreign ministry.
translations.idiomatic: China protested to the German minister and had Envoy Li Fengbao argue the case in Berlin.

sentences.zh: 時德相為畢士馬克，電致巴使，命速令師船退出，並撤領事任。

translations.literal: At this time the German chancellor was Bismarck; he telegraphed the German envoy in China ordering the warships to withdraw promptly and the consul to be removed from office.
translations.idiomatic: Chancellor Bismarck telegraphed Brandt to withdraw the warships and recall the consul.

sentences.zh: 已，德使歸咎中國地方官，屢請派員查辦，議久不決。

translations.literal: Thereafter the German envoy blamed Chinese local officials and repeatedly requested that commissioners be sent to investigate; negotiations dragged on without resolution.
translations.idiomatic: The German envoy then blamed local officials and repeatedly demanded an investigation, and talks dragged on.

sentences.zh: 至是，總署從李鴻章議，令赫德派洋員會同粵員議辦，遂辦結。

translations.literal: At this point the Foreign Office, following Li Hongzhang's proposal, ordered Hart to send foreign staff together with Guangdong officials to settle the matter, and it was concluded.
translations.idiomatic: The Yamen then followed Li Hongzhang's plan and had Hart's foreign staff work with Guangdong officials to close the case.

sentences.zh: 十年，贈德皇景泰窯器，答歷次派員監造鐵艦、撥借魚雷及兵船教習等事，修好也。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, Jingdezhen porcelain was presented to the German emperor in return for successive missions to supervise construction of ironclads, loans of torpedoes, and naval instruction—renewing friendly relations.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, China gifted Jingdezhen ware to the German emperor in thanks for ironclad construction, torpedo loans, and naval training—an exchange of goodwill.

sentences.zh: 十二年春二月，出使英國大臣曾紀澤將回華，德駐英公使伯爵哈子斐爾德遣參贊官伯爵美塔尼克來言，德皇暨德相畢斯馬克欲與晤談，邀臨其國，遂遊各製造局廠。

translations.literal: In the spring of the twelfth year, the second month, Envoy to Britain Zeng Jize was about to return to China; the German minister in London, Count Hatzfeldt, sent Counsellor Count Metternich to say that the German emperor and Chancellor Bismarck wished to meet him and invited him to visit Germany, whereupon he toured the various factories.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of spring in the twelfth year, as Zeng Jize was returning from London, Count Hatzfeldt's counsellor Metternich invited him to meet the Kaiser and Bismarck in Germany, and he toured German factories.

sentences.zh: 十四年秋七月，德皇薨，命出使大臣洪鈞弔唁，德命駐華公使巴蘭德致謝。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the fourteenth year, the seventh month, the German emperor died; Envoy Hong Jun was ordered to offer condolences, and Germany ordered Resident Minister Brandt in China to express thanks.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn in the fourteenth year, the German emperor died; Hong Jun was sent to mourn and Brandt returned thanks in Beijing.

sentences.zh: 二十年夏四月，德人阿爾和欲在漢口建火油池。

translations.literal: In the summer of the twentieth year, the fourth month, the German Arhe wanted to build a kerosene depot at Hankou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer in the twentieth year, a German named Arhe sought to build a kerosene depot at Hankou.

sentences.zh: 初，德商在上海創設火油池棧，許之。

translations.literal: Initially, German merchants had established a kerosene depot and warehouse in Shanghai; this was permitted.
translations.idiomatic: German merchants had already been allowed a kerosene depot in Shanghai.

sentences.zh: 既又欲於漢口購地踵建，不許。

translations.literal: They then also wished to purchase land at Hankou and build another; this was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: A second depot at Hankou was refused.

sentences.zh: 德使爭辯，旋議將火油照巿價收買，及償造油制器各費，德使仍不從。

translations.literal: The German envoy argued; China then proposed to buy the kerosene at market price and compensate the costs of oil-making equipment; the German envoy still would not agree.
translations.idiomatic: The German minister protested; China offered to buy the kerosene at market price and pay for equipment, but he refused.

sentences.zh: 明年，又請增開天津、漢口租界，許之。

translations.literal: The following year, he again requested expansion of the concessions at Tianjin and Hankou; this was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The following year, expansion of the Tianjin and Hankou concessions was granted.

sentences.zh: 二十二年春正月，德外部馬沙爾求在中國借地泊船，出使大臣許景澄以告。

translations.literal: In the spring of the twenty-second year, the first month, German foreign minister Marschall requested to borrow land in China to anchor warships; Envoy Xu Jingcheng reported this.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in the twenty-second year, Foreign Minister Marschall asked to lease anchorage in China; Xu Jingcheng reported it.

sentences.zh: 時李鴻章使德將還，留稅務司德璀琳與德外部商辦加稅事，德廷謂須中國讓給兵船埠地始允加稅，德璀琳阻之，不省。

translations.literal: At this time Li Hongzhang, envoy to Germany, was about to return; he left Customs Commissioner Detring to negotiate increased duties with the German foreign ministry; the German court said China must grant a naval anchorage before it would agree to higher tariffs; Detring blocked this, but they would not understand.
translations.idiomatic: As Li Hongzhang was leaving Germany, Detring negotiated tariff increases; Berlin demanded a naval base in return, which Detring opposed, but Germany would not yield.

sentences.zh: 二十三年十月，山東曹州府钜野縣有暴徒殺德教士二人，德以兵艦入膠州灣，逼守將章高元退出砲台，佔領之。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the twenty-third year, rioters in Juye county, Caozhou prefecture, Shandong, killed two German missionaries; Germany sent warships into Jiaozhou Bay, forced the garrison commander Zhang Gaoyuan to abandon the forts, and occupied them.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the twenty-third year, rioters in Juye, Shandong, killed two German missionaries; Germany seized Jiaozhou Bay and drove Zhang Gaoyuan from the forts.

sentences.zh: 德使海靖向總署要求六款：一，革巡撫李秉衡職，永不敘用；

translations.literal: German minister Heinze demanded six articles from the Foreign Office: first, dismiss Governor Li Bingheng from office and never employ him again;
translations.idiomatic: Minister Heinze demanded six terms from the Yamen: first, dismiss Governor Li Bingheng permanently;

sentences.zh: 二，給天主堂建築費六萬六千兩，賠償盜竊物品銀三千兩；

translations.literal: second, pay sixty-six thousand taels for cathedral construction and three thousand taels for stolen goods;
translations.idiomatic: second, pay sixty-six thousand taels for church buildings and three thousand for stolen goods;

sentences.zh: 三，钜野、菏澤、鄆城、單縣、曹縣、魚台、武涉七處，各建教師住房，共給工費二萬四千兩；

translations.literal: third, at seven places—Juye, Heze, Yuncheng, Shan county, Cao county, Yutai, and Wushe—build residences for teachers in each, totaling twenty-four thousand taels in construction costs;
translations.idiomatic: third, build teachers' houses in seven counties at a total cost of twenty-four thousand taels;

sentences.zh: 四，保以後永無此等事件；

translations.literal: fourth, guarantee that such incidents would never occur again;
translations.idiomatic: fourth, guarantee that such incidents would never recur;

sentences.zh: 五，以兩國人資本設立德華公司，築造山東全省鐵道，並許開採鐵道附近之礦山；

translations.literal: fifth, establish the Sino-German company with capital from both countries to build railways throughout Shandong and permit mining of minerals near the railways;
translations.idiomatic: fifth, establish a Sino-German company to build railways across Shandong and mine along the lines;

sentences.zh: 六，德國辦理此案費用，均由中國賠償。

translations.literal: sixth, all costs incurred by Germany in handling this case were to be compensated by China.
translations.idiomatic: sixth, China was to pay all German costs in the case.

sentences.zh: 總署屢與折沖，始將第一款「永不敘用」四字刪去；

translations.literal: The Foreign Office bargained repeatedly and finally had the four characters "never employ again" deleted from the first article;
translations.idiomatic: After repeated bargaining, the Yamen deleted "never employ again" from the first article;

sentences.zh: 二、三兩款全允；

translations.literal: the second and third articles were fully accepted;
translations.idiomatic: accepted the second and third articles in full;

sentences.zh: 四、六兩款全削除；

translations.literal: the fourth and sixth articles were entirely deleted;
translations.idiomatic: deleted the fourth and sixth entirely;

sentences.zh: 五款許以膠州灣至濟南府一段鐵道由德築造。

translations.literal: the fifth article was granted only as far as allowing Germany to build the railway section from Jiaozhou Bay to Jinan prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: and limited the fifth to a railway from Jiaozhou Bay to Jinan.

sentences.zh: 議漸就緒，忽曹州有驅逐教師、殺害洋人之說，德使復要求租借膠州灣。

translations.literal: Negotiations were nearing completion when suddenly there were reports from Caozhou of expelling teachers and killing foreigners; the German envoy again demanded a lease of Jiaozhou Bay.
translations.idiomatic: Talks were nearly done when fresh unrest in Caozhou led Heinze to demand a lease of Jiaozhou Bay.

sentences.zh: 二十四年二月，總署與德使海靖另訂專條三章。

translations.literal: In the second month of the twenty-fourth year, the Foreign Office and German minister Heinze separately concluded a special treaty of three chapters.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the twenty-fourth year, the Yamen and Heinze signed a separate three-chapter treaty.

sentences.zh: 一章，膠州灣租界：一，灣內各島嶼及灣口與口外海面之群島，又灣東北岸自陰島東北角起劃一線東南行至勞山灣止，灣西南岸自齊伯山島對岸劃一線西南行至笛羅山島止，又灣內全水面以最高潮為標之地，皆為租借區域；

translations.literal: Chapter One, Jiaozhou Bay concession: first, all islands within the bay and at the mouth and the archipelagos on the outer sea, and on the northeast shore from the northeast corner of Yin Island a line drawn southeast to Laoshan Bay, and on the southwest shore from opposite Qibo Mountain Island a line drawn southwest to Diluo Mountain Island, and all waters within the bay up to the high-tide mark—all were leased territory;
translations.idiomatic: Chapter One, the Jiaozhou Bay lease: all islands in and at the mouth of the bay, lines from Yin Island southeast to Laoshan Bay and from opposite Qibo Mountain southwest to Diluo Mountain, and all waters to the high-tide mark, formed the leased zone;

sentences.zh: 二，租借區域，德國得行使主權、建築砲台等事，但不得轉租與他國；

translations.literal: second, within the leased territory Germany might exercise sovereignty, build forts, and the like, but might not sublease to other states;
translations.idiomatic: second, Germany might exercise sovereignty and build forts there, but could not sublease to other powers;

sentences.zh: 中國軍艦商船來往，均照德國所定各國往來船舶章程一例待遇；

translations.literal: Chinese warships and merchant vessels coming and going were all to be treated alike under the regulations Germany set for vessels of all nations;
translations.idiomatic: Chinese naval and merchant traffic would follow Germany's general port regulations;

sentences.zh: 三，租借期限以九十九年為期，如限內還中國，則德國在膠州灣所用款項由中國償還，另以相當地域讓與德國；

translations.literal: third, the lease term was ninety-nine years; if within the term it were returned to China, Germany's expenditures at Jiaozhou Bay would be repaid by China and equivalent territory granted to Germany;
translations.idiomatic: third, the lease ran ninety-nine years; if China recovered the bay early, it would repay German expenses and grant equivalent territory;

sentences.zh: 四，自膠州灣水面潮平點起，周圍中里一百里之陸地為中立地，主權雖歸中國，然中國若備屯軍隊，須先得德國許可，但德國軍隊有自由通過之權。

translations.literal: fourth, from the mean tide level of Jiaozhou Bay waters, land within one hundred Chinese li in all directions was neutral territory; sovereignty remained with China, yet if China stationed troops it must first obtain German permission, but German troops had the right of free passage.
translations.idiomatic: fourth, a neutral belt of one hundred li around the bay remained Chinese in sovereignty, but China could not station troops without German consent while German troops might pass freely.

sentences.zh: 二章，鐵道礦務辦法：一，中國准德國在山東築造自膠州灣經濰縣、青州等處至濟南及山東界，又自膠州灣至沂州經萊蕪至濟南之二鐵道；

translations.literal: Chapter Two, railway and mining provisions: first, China permitted Germany to build in Shandong two railways—one from Jiaozhou Bay through Weixian, Qingzhou, and other places to Jinan and the Shandong border, and another from Jiaozhou Bay to Yizhou via Laiwu to Jinan;
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Two, railways and mines: China allowed Germany two Shandong lines—from Jiaozhou Bay via Weixian and Qingzhou to Jinan and the provincial border, and from Jiaozhou Bay via Yizhou and Laiwu to Jinan;

sentences.zh: 二，鐵道附近左右各三十里中國里內之礦產，德商有開採之權。

translations.literal: second, mineral resources within thirty Chinese li on either side of the railways might be mined by German merchants.
translations.idiomatic: second, German merchants might mine minerals within thirty li on either side of the lines.

sentences.zh: 三章，山東全省開辦各項事務：一，以後山東省內開辦何項事務，或須外資，或須外料，或聘外人，德國有侭先承辦之權。

translations.literal: Chapter Three, undertakings throughout Shandong: first, whenever any enterprise was launched in Shandong requiring foreign capital, foreign materials, or foreign employees, Germany had the right of first contract.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Three, Shandong enterprises: Germany had first right to any project in the province needing foreign capital, materials, or personnel.

sentences.zh: 是為中德膠澳租界條約。

translations.literal: This was the Sino-German Jiaozhou Bay lease treaty.
translations.idiomatic: This was the Sino-German Jiaozhou Bay lease treaty.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，山東日照教案起，德人進兵據城，案結仍不退。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year, the Rizhao missionary case arose in Shandong; Germans advanced troops and seized the city; even after the case was settled they still did not withdraw.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year, after the Rizhao missionary incident, German troops seized the city and did not leave even after settlement.

sentences.zh: 又中國擬修天津至鎮江鐵路，德人阻之，並欲自修濟南至沂州一段，總署不許。

translations.literal: China also planned to build a railway from Tianjin to Zhenjiang; Germans obstructed this and also wished to build the section from Jinan to Yizhou themselves; the Foreign Office did not permit it.
translations.idiomatic: Germany blocked China's Tianjin–Zhenjiang railway and sought to build the Jinan–Yizhou line itself; the Yamen refused.

sentences.zh: 又要求中國借德款，用德工程師。

translations.literal: They also demanded that China borrow German funds and employ German engineers.
translations.idiomatic: Germany also demanded Chinese loans and German engineers.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，山東高密民人阻德人修鐵路，山東巡撫袁世凱諭解之，因立鐵路章程，設華商德商膠濟鐵路公司，立交涉局，招股購地丈量建築。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year, the people of Gaomi, Shandong, obstructed Germans building the railway; Shandong governor Yuan Shikai ordered them to disperse; railway regulations were then drawn up, the Sino-German Jiaoji Railway Company of Chinese and German merchants was established, a negotiations office was set up, and shares were sold to purchase land, survey, and build.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year, Gaomi residents blocked railway construction; Governor Yuan Shikai dispersed them, drew up regulations, founded the Jiaoji Railway Company, and set up a negotiations office to raise capital, buy land, and build.

sentences.zh: 又立膠澳交涉章程十一款：一，兩國交涉案件，須兩國會辦；

translations.literal: Eleven regulations for Jiaozhou negotiations were also established: first, cases between the two countries must be handled jointly by both sides;
translations.idiomatic: Eleven Jiaozhou negotiation rules were also adopted: first, bilateral cases must be handled jointly;

sentences.zh: 二，德人遊歷，須發護照；

translations.literal: second, Germans traveling must be issued passports;
translations.idiomatic: second, Germans traveling inland required passports;

sentences.zh: 三，兩國交涉事，統由交涉官商辦；

translations.literal: third, all matters between the two countries were to be handled by negotiation officers;
translations.idiomatic: third, all bilateral matters went to negotiation officers;

sentences.zh: 四，青島租界內華洋案件，歸交涉官提訊審斷；

translations.literal: fourth, Chinese and foreign cases within the Qingdao concession were to be tried and judged by negotiation officers;
translations.idiomatic: fourth, mixed cases in the Qingdao concession were tried by negotiation officers;

sentences.zh: 五，租界內華人牽涉德人案件，須德官會同山東交涉官審問；

translations.literal: fifth, cases within the concession in which Chinese were involved with Germans required German officials to sit jointly with Shandong negotiation officers for trial;
translations.idiomatic: fifth, Chinese cases involving Germans in the concession required joint German and Shandong hearings;

sentences.zh: 六，德雇用華民之案，須由德官審訊；

translations.literal: sixth, cases of Germans employing Chinese were to be tried by German officials;
translations.idiomatic: sixth, cases involving Germans employing Chinese were tried by German officials;

sentences.zh: 七，華人案件，仍由華審斷；

translations.literal: seventh, cases among Chinese were still to be judged by Chinese authorities;
translations.idiomatic: seventh, cases among Chinese remained under Chinese jurisdiction;

sentences.zh: 八，租界外罪犯逃入青島華民及德人住處者，分別由華官、德官提拏解交；

translations.literal: eighth, criminals from outside the concession fleeing into Qingdao Chinese or German residences were to be arrested and handed over respectively by Chinese or German officials;
translations.idiomatic: eighth, fugitives from outside the concession hiding in Qingdao were arrested by Chinese or German officials as appropriate;

sentences.zh: 九，華、德人在租界內外行兇，華、德兵均可拿禁解交；

translations.literal: ninth, when Chinese or Germans committed violence inside or outside the concession, Chinese or German troops might arrest and hand them over;
translations.idiomatic: ninth, Chinese or German troops might arrest violent offenders inside or outside the concession;

sentences.zh: 十，華、德官商辦案件，須和衷；

translations.literal: tenth, Chinese and German officials handling cases must act in harmony;
translations.idiomatic: tenth, Chinese and German officials were to cooperate in handling cases;

sentences.zh: 十一，重大案件，本省不能結者，由總署及駐京德使商辦。

translations.literal: eleventh, major cases the province could not settle were to be negotiated by the Foreign Office and the German minister resident in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: eleventh, major cases the province could not settle went to the Yamen and the German minister in Beijing.

sentences.zh: 又與德議立礦務章程，未定，二十六年五月，駐京德使克林德為拳匪所戕。

translations.literal: Negotiations with Germany to establish mining regulations were also unsettled; in the fifth month of the twenty-sixth year, the German minister resident in the capital, von Ketteler, was killed by Boxer bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Mining regulations with Germany were still unsettled when, in the fifth month of the twenty-sixth year, Minister von Ketteler was killed by Boxers.

sentences.zh: 七月，德與英、法、俄、美、日本、荷蘭、意、比、奧、瑞十一國聯軍入北京，推德將瓦德西為總司令。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, Germany together with Britain, France, Russia, the United States, Japan, the Netherlands, Italy, Belgium, Austria, and Switzerland—eleven nations' allied forces—entered Beijing and elected the German general Waldersee commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, an eleven-power allied force including Germany entered Beijing and made General Waldersee commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 瓦德西入居禁城儀鑾殿。

translations.literal: Waldersee took up residence in the Yiluan Hall within the Forbidden City.
translations.idiomatic: Waldersee occupied the Yiluan Hall in the Forbidden City.

sentences.zh: 時命李鴻章為全權大臣，入京議和。

translations.literal: At this time Li Hongzhang was appointed plenipotentiary and entered the capital to negotiate peace.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hongzhang was then appointed plenipotentiary to negotiate peace in Beijing.

sentences.zh: 各國提出條款：一，中國政府為被戕德公使克林德置立石碑；

translations.literal: The powers presented terms: first, the Chinese government was to erect a stone monument for the murdered German minister von Ketteler;
translations.idiomatic: The powers demanded: first, a monument to murdered minister von Ketteler;

sentences.zh: 一，中國政府應派親王前往德國謝罪；

translations.literal: second, the Chinese government should send a prince to Germany to offer an apology;
translations.idiomatic: second, a prince was to go to Germany to apologize;

sentences.zh: 一，將總理衙門撤去；

translations.literal: third, abolish the Zongli Yamen;
translations.idiomatic: third, abolish the Zongli Yamen;

sentences.zh: 一，嚴辦禍首；

translations.literal: fourth, severely punish the ringleaders;
translations.idiomatic: fourth, punish the ringleaders severely;

sentences.zh: 一，廢去大沽口及直隸各處砲台；

translations.literal: fifth, dismantle the forts at Dagu and throughout Zhili;
translations.idiomatic: fifth, dismantle the forts at Dagu and in Zhili;

sentences.zh: 一，禁止軍裝砲火入口；

translations.literal: sixth, prohibit import of military arms and munitions;
translations.idiomatic: sixth, ban imports of arms and munitions;

sentences.zh: 一，各省有曾經殺戮西人，停止鄉試小考五年；

translations.literal: seventh, in provinces where Westerners had been killed, suspend provincial and lower examinations for five years;
translations.idiomatic: seventh, suspend local examinations for five years in provinces where foreigners had been killed;

sentences.zh: 一，有事直達中國皇上；

translations.literal: eighth, matters were to be communicated directly to the Chinese emperor;
translations.idiomatic: eighth, diplomatic matters were to go directly to the emperor;

sentences.zh: 一，駐華各使館永遠設兵保護；

translations.literal: ninth, permanently station troops to guard the legations in China;
translations.idiomatic: ninth, permanently garrison the legations;

sentences.zh: 一，由京至海電報郵政設兵保護；

translations.literal: tenth, station troops to protect telegraph and postal lines from the capital to the sea;
translations.idiomatic: tenth, protect telegraph and postal lines from Beijing to the coast;

sentences.zh: 一，國家公司以及私產均照賠。

translations.literal: eleventh, indemnify state and private property alike.
translations.idiomatic: eleventh, indemnify all state and private property.

sentences.zh: 久之始定議，共十二款，而為克林德立碑京城，及遣醇王載灃入德謝罪，均如所請行。

translations.literal: After a long time agreement was reached in twelve articles; erecting a monument to Ketteler in the capital and sending Prince Chun Zai Feng to Germany to apologize were both carried out as requested.
translations.idiomatic: Talks finally produced twelve articles; the Ketteler monument in Beijing and Prince Chun's apology mission to Germany were carried out as demanded.

sentences.zh: 十月，獲戕德使克林德犯恩海，交德駐京提督誅之。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, En Hai, who had killed Minister Ketteler, was captured and handed to the German commandant in Beijing for execution.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, Ketteler's killer En Hai was captured and handed to the German commandant in Beijing for execution.

sentences.zh: 明年，醇親王載灃至德，見德皇遞書，時帶廕昌一人，俱行鞠躬禮。

translations.literal: The following year, Prince Chun Zai Feng reached Germany, met the German emperor and presented a letter; he was accompanied by Yin Chang alone, and both performed the bow.
translations.idiomatic: The following year Prince Chun Zai Feng met the Kaiser in Germany with Yin Chang; both bowed as they presented China's letter.

sentences.zh: 二十八年秋七月，德商在漢口華界偪近襄河口請設立躉船，駮之。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the twenty-eighth year, the seventh month, German merchants in the Chinese quarter at Hankou near the Xiang River mouth requested to set up lighters; this was rejected.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn in the twenty-eighth year, German merchants' request for lighters near the Xiang River mouth at Hankou was refused.

sentences.zh: 時政府要求德及英、法、日本撤兵，德使聞他國有在揚子江獨享中國特予權利者，請定明長江上下游進兵要隘不得讓與他國，以定撤兵日期，拒之。

translations.literal: At this time the government demanded that Germany, Britain, France, and Japan withdraw troops; hearing that other states enjoyed exclusive Chinese privileges on the Yangtze, the German envoy asked that it be stipulated that strategic points on the upper and lower Yangtze might not be ceded to other powers, as a condition for fixing a withdrawal date; this was refused.
translations.idiomatic: As China pressed Germany, Britain, France, and Japan to withdraw, the German minister tried to secure exclusive Yangtze strongpoints before setting a withdrawal date; China refused.

sentences.zh: 三十年，與德會訂小清河岔路合同。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year, China and Germany concluded a contract for a branch line on the Xiaoqing River.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirtieth year, China and Germany signed a contract for a Xiaoqing River branch line.

sentences.zh: 初，膠濟鐵路章程原不許擅行另造枝路，今為商務便利計，特委膠濟鐵路公司代辦。

translations.literal: Initially the Jiaoji Railway regulations did not permit unauthorized branch lines; now for commercial convenience the Jiaoji Railway Company was specially entrusted to handle it.
translations.idiomatic: The Jiaoji Railway charter had barred unauthorized branch lines; for commercial convenience the company was now entrusted to build this one.

sentences.zh: 是年，德水艦隊擬入長江及各內河遊巡演砲，阻之。

translations.literal: That year the German naval squadron planned to enter the Yangtze and various inland rivers on gunboat tours; this was blocked.
translations.idiomatic: That year Germany's plan to cruise gunboats on the Yangtze and inland rivers was blocked.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，德撤退膠州、高密兩處兵隊。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year, Germany withdrew troops from Jiaozhou and Gaomi.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-first year, Germany withdrew troops from Jiaozhou and Gaomi.

sentences.zh: 初，德人在山東修造膠濟鐵路，因高密民聚眾阻工，先後由青島派兵赴膠、高保護鐵路。

translations.literal: Initially, as Germans built the Jiaoji Railway in Shandong, Gaomi residents gathered to obstruct the work; troops were repeatedly sent from Qingdao to Jiaozhou and Gaomi to protect the railway.
translations.idiomatic: While Germans built the Jiaoji Railway in Shandong, Gaomi residents obstructed the work and troops were sent from Qingdao to protect the line.

sentences.zh: 山東巡撫袁世凱派員查辦議結，駐膠德兵旋即撤回青島。

translations.literal: Shandong governor Yuan Shikai sent officers to investigate and settle the matter; the German troops stationed at Jiaozhou were soon withdrawn to Qingdao.
translations.idiomatic: Governor Yuan Shikai settled the dispute and the German garrison at Jiaozhou returned to Qingdao.

sentences.zh: 既，拳匪滋事，德人又派兵分駐膠州，並於城北車站旁價購民地十四畝，修造兵房。

translations.literal: Thereafter, when the Boxers caused trouble, Germans again sent troops to garrison Jiaozhou and purchased fourteen mu of civilian land beside the north station to build barracks.
translations.idiomatic: After the Boxer rising, Germany re-garrisoned Jiaozhou and bought fourteen mu beside the north station for barracks.

sentences.zh: 二十九年秋，又于附近沈家河續租民地七畝，安設水管，以便取汲。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the twenty-ninth year, they also leased seven more mu of civilian land at nearby Shenjia River and installed water pipes for drawing water.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn of the twenty-ninth year they leased seven more mu at Shenjia River and laid water pipes.

sentences.zh: 高密兵隊先駐城內，後又在城外古城地方議租民地九十餘畝，修造兵房，議定以六個月為限。

translations.literal: The Gaomi garrison was first stationed inside the city, then negotiated to lease more than ninety mu of civilian land at the old city outside the walls to build barracks, agreed for a limit of six months.
translations.idiomatic: Gaomi troops were first stationed in the city, then leased over ninety mu outside the old walls for barracks on a six-month term.

sentences.zh: 尋又修築由古城至小王莊火車站馬路一道。

translations.literal: Soon they also built a road from the old city to Xiaowangzhuang railway station.
translations.idiomatic: They then built a road from the old city to Xiaowangzhuang station.

sentences.zh: 時六個月限期已滿，東撫商令退兵，屢延展，至是始訂撤兵善後事宜五款，遂議結。

translations.literal: When the six-month term had expired, the Shandong governor negotiated for troop withdrawal; extensions were repeatedly granted; only now were five articles on withdrawal and aftermath settled, and the matter concluded.
translations.idiomatic: When the six-month term expired, the Shandong governor pressed for withdrawal; after repeated extensions, five withdrawal articles were finally agreed.

sentences.zh: 又議商約，朝廷派呂海寰、盛宣懷為商約大臣。

translations.literal: Commercial treaty negotiations were also held; the court appointed Lü Haihuan and Sheng Xuanhuai commercial treaty commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: Commercial treaty talks followed; Lü Haihuan and Sheng Xuanhuai were appointed commissioners.

sentences.zh: 德人提出十四款，袁世凱、張之洞往返電商，海寰等與德使穆默、總領事克納俱迭次會議，彼此堅持。

translations.literal: The Germans proposed fourteen articles; Yuan Shikai and Zhang Zhidong exchanged telegrams; Lü Haihuan and others met repeatedly with German minister Mumm and consul-general Knoll, each side holding firm.
translations.idiomatic: Germany proposed fourteen articles; Yuan Shikai and Zhang Zhidong consulted by telegram; Lü Haihuan met repeatedly with Minister Mumm and Consul-General Knoll, and both sides held firm.

sentences.zh: 至三十三年，始議定條約十三款，在北京互換。

translations.literal: Only in the thirty-third year were thirteen treaty articles finally agreed and exchanged in Beijing.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-third year, thirteen articles were finally agreed and exchanged in Beijing.

sentences.zh: 第一款，釐金：中國政府與諸國立約裁撤現有之釐金，加增進出口之關稅以抵裁釐。

translations.literal: Article 1, Likin: the Chinese government, in treaties with the powers, agreed to abolish existing likin and increase import and export customs duties to offset the abolition.
translations.idiomatic: Article 1, Likin: China agreed with the powers to abolish likin and raise import and export duties to compensate.

sentences.zh: 此約須立約各國派員議決，德國政府亦允派員議結此事，惟中國須當擔保釐金定必全行裁撤方可。

translations.literal: This required delegates from all treaty powers to decide; the German government also agreed to send delegates, but China must guarantee that likin would certainly be wholly abolished.
translations.idiomatic: All treaty powers were to decide by conference; Germany agreed to send delegates, provided China guaranteed full abolition of likin.

sentences.zh: 第二款，住居：德國人民及德國保護之人民，准在中國已開及日後所開為外國人民通商各口岸或通商地方，往來居住，辦理商工各業製造等事，以及他項合例事業；

translations.literal: Article 2, Residence: German nationals and persons under German protection were permitted to reside, travel, and conduct commerce, industry, manufacturing, and other lawful business in Chinese ports already opened and those to be opened hereafter for foreign trade;
translations.idiomatic: Article 2, Residence: Germans and persons under German protection might live and do business in opened and future treaty ports;

sentences.zh: 且准租買房屋、地基、經商之地及他項實產，並可在租買之地內建造房屋。

translations.literal: and were permitted to lease or purchase houses, land, trading sites, and other real property, and to build houses on leased or purchased land.
translations.idiomatic: and might lease or buy property and build on it.

sentences.zh: 第三款，關棧：中國政府允准在通商口岸設法屯積洋貨及拆包改裝等事。

translations.literal: Article 3, Bonded warehouses: the Chinese government permitted arrangements at treaty ports to store foreign goods and repack or refit them.
translations.idiomatic: Article 3, Bonded warehouses: China permitted bonded storage and repacking at treaty ports.

sentences.zh: 中國政府一經由德領事請將某德商或德國保護人民之棧得享關棧之利益，則中國政府須准如所請，惟須遵照海關所訂之專章辦理，以保餉源。

translations.literal: Once the German consul requested bonded-warehouse benefits for a German merchant or protected person, the Chinese government must grant it as requested, but subject to customs regulations to protect revenue.
translations.idiomatic: When the German consul requested bonded-warehouse status for a German firm, China had to grant it under customs regulations to protect revenue.

sentences.zh: 海關官員又須與各國領事議定關棧專章，以及規費若干，須按照該棧離關遠近，屯何貨物，並工作早晚，酌量核定。

translations.literal: Customs officials were also to agree with consuls on bonded-warehouse regulations and fees, assessed according to distance from the customs house, goods stored, and hours of operation.
translations.idiomatic: Customs and consuls were to set warehouse rules and fees based on distance, goods stored, and hours of work.

sentences.zh: 凡在通商地方所設之關棧，德國人民及德國保護人民均准用之。

translations.literal: All bonded warehouses established in trading places might be used by German nationals and persons under German protection.
translations.idiomatic: Germans and persons under German protection might use all bonded warehouses in trading places.

sentences.zh: 第四款，礦務：中國政府振興礦務，並招徠外洋資本興辦礦業，故允自簽押此約之日起，於一年內，仿照德國及他國現行礦務章程，頒發礦務新章，以期一面振興中國人民之利益，於中國主權毫無妨礙，一面於招致外洋資財無礙，且比較諸國通行章程，於礦商亦不致有虧。

translations.literal: Article 4, Mining: to develop mining and attract foreign capital, China agreed that within one year from signing it would issue new mining regulations modeled on German and other current codes, to advance Chinese interests without impairing sovereignty, facilitate foreign investment, and not disadvantage miners compared with other countries' rules.
translations.idiomatic: Article 4, Mining: within one year China would issue new mining regulations modeled on German and other codes to develop the industry, protect sovereignty, attract foreign capital, and treat miners fairly.

sentences.zh: 是以中國政府須准德國人民及德國保護人民在中國地方開辦礦務及礦務內所應辦之事。

translations.literal: Therefore the Chinese government must permit German nationals and protected persons to undertake mining and related operations in China.
translations.idiomatic: Germany and protected persons were therefore permitted to undertake mining in China.

sentences.zh: 凡所辦礦業，不得因稅項之故致其財源有所虧損，除徵抽淨利之稅及礦產之地稅外，不得另抽他項之稅。

translations.literal: Mining enterprises might not be taxed so as to impair their finances; apart from taxes on net profits and land taxes on mineral property, no other taxes might be levied.
translations.idiomatic: Mining might be taxed only on net profits and mineral land; no other taxes applied.

sentences.zh: 第五款，貨稅：還稅之存票，須自商人稟請之日起，如查系應領者，限於二十一日內由海關發給。

translations.literal: Article 5, Duties: drawback deposit receipts must be issued by customs within twenty-one days from the merchant's application if found due.
translations.idiomatic: Article 5, Duties: drawback receipts were to be issued within twenty-one days of application if due.

sentences.zh: 此等存票，可用在各處海關，按所載銀數，除子口稅一項外，以抵各項出入口貨稅。

translations.literal: Such receipts might be used at any customs house for the silver amount stated, except for transit dues, to offset import and export duties.
translations.idiomatic: These receipts could be used at any customs house for the stated amount, except transit dues, against import and export taxes.

sentences.zh: 至洋貨入口後三年之內，轉運外洋，凡執持此等存票者，即准任便在發給之港向海關銀號按全數領取現銀。

translations.literal: For foreign goods re-exported within three years of import, holders of such receipts might freely collect the full amount in silver from the customs bank at the issuing port.
translations.idiomatic: For re-export within three years, holders might collect the full amount in silver at the issuing port.

sentences.zh: 倘請發存票之人意圖走漏關稅，一經查出，則須罰銀，照其所圖騙之數不得逾五倍，或將其貨入官。

translations.literal: If the applicant intended to evade customs duties and was discovered, a fine of up to five times the amount sought might be imposed, or the goods confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: Fraudulent drawback claims incurred fines up to five times the amount or confiscation of goods.

sentences.zh: 第六款，保護商標：凡中國商標，一經呈出在中國各領事所給之據，證明此項商標已在中國認可，且實屬於稟請之人者，均可在德國享保護之利益，與德國之商標相同。

translations.literal: Article 6, Trademarks: Chinese trademarks, once certificates from Chinese consuls showed registration in China and ownership by the applicant, enjoyed protection in Germany equal to German trademarks.
translations.idiomatic: Article 6, Trademarks: registered Chinese trademarks enjoyed the same protection in Germany as German marks.

sentences.zh: 華商之姓名牌號，必須在德國保護，以免仿冒。

translations.literal: Chinese merchants' names and trade marks must be protected in Germany against imitation.
translations.idiomatic: Chinese merchants' names and marks were to be protected in Germany against counterfeiting.

sentences.zh: 德國商標亦須在中國保護，以防假冒，惟須呈出德國官員並領事所給之據，證明該商標實已在德國註冊，德商之姓名商標以及中國行名均須保護。

translations.literal: German trademarks must also be protected in China against counterfeiting, upon certificates from German officials and consuls proving registration in Germany; German merchants' names, trademarks, and Chinese firm names must all be protected.
translations.idiomatic: German trademarks registered in Germany were likewise protected in China, along with German and Chinese firm names.

sentences.zh: 凡德商包裹貨物之特法，在中國之同業曾已認為某行用以區別某項貨物者，亦須一律保護。

translations.literal: German merchants' special methods of packing goods, recognized by the trade in China as distinguishing certain goods of a firm, must likewise be protected.
translations.idiomatic: Distinctive German packing methods recognized in the Chinese trade were also protected.

sentences.zh: 德國保護之人民亦能享以上所言之利益。

translations.literal: Persons under German protection might also enjoy the benefits stated above.
translations.idiomatic: Persons under German protection enjoyed the same benefits.

sentences.zh: 商標註冊局一經成立，保護商標章程亦已刊佈，則中、德兩國必須開議特約，以便彼此保護商標。

translations.literal: Once trademark registration offices were established and protection regulations published, China and Germany must negotiate a special treaty for mutual trademark protection.
translations.idiomatic: Once registration offices were established, China and Germany were to negotiate a special trademark treaty.

sentences.zh: 至此約未議之前，以上之款必須施行。

translations.literal: Until that treaty was negotiated, the above provisions must be enforced.
translations.idiomatic: Until then, the above provisions applied.

sentences.zh: 第七款，營業：中國人民購買他國營業及公司之股票，是否合例，尚未明定。

translations.literal: Article 7, Business: whether Chinese might purchase shares in foreign businesses and companies was not yet clearly defined.
translations.idiomatic: Article 7, Business: whether Chinese could buy foreign company shares had not been clearly defined.

sentences.zh: 又因華民如此購買，為數頗巨，故中國現將華民或已購買或將來購買他國公司股票，均認為合例。

translations.literal: Because such purchases by Chinese were considerable in number, China now recognized as lawful both past and future Chinese purchases of foreign company shares.
translations.idiomatic: Given the scale of such purchases, China now recognized past and future Chinese share purchases as lawful.

sentences.zh: 凡同一合資公司，原入股購票者，彼此一律，不得稍有歧異。

translations.literal: In any joint-stock company, original shareholders must be treated alike without discrimination.
translations.idiomatic: Shareholders in any joint-stock company were to be treated equally.

sentences.zh: 遇有華民購買德公司股份者，應將該人民購買股份之舉，即作為已允遵守該公司訂定法律章程，並原按德國公堂解釋該法律章程辦法之據。

translations.literal: When Chinese purchased German company shares, that purchase was to be taken as consent to abide by the company's articles and to accept German courts' interpretation of them.
translations.idiomatic: Chinese who bought German shares were deemed to accept the company's articles and German court interpretation.

sentences.zh: 倘不遵辦，致被公司控告，中國公堂應即飭令買股份之華民遵守該章程，當與德國公堂飭令買股份之德國人民相等無異，不得另有苛求。

translations.literal: If they failed to comply and were sued by the company, Chinese courts must order the Chinese shareholder to obey the articles, on the same terms as German courts ordered German shareholders, without extra demands.
translations.idiomatic: If sued, Chinese courts were to enforce the articles against Chinese shareholders as German courts did against Germans, without extra demands.

sentences.zh: 德國人民如購中國公司股票，其當守本分，與華民之有股份者相同。

translations.literal: Germans who purchased Chinese company shares must observe the same obligations as Chinese shareholders.
translations.idiomatic: Germans who bought Chinese shares had the same obligations as Chinese shareholders.

sentences.zh: 凡尋常合資股東，及一人或數人有無限之責任，與一人或數人有有限之責任，為合資股東，在德屬經商之有限合資公司註冊，合辦會社有限公司，及各項商業公司等，均須按照以上二節辦理。

translations.literal: Ordinary partners, unlimited-liability partners, limited-liability partners, limited partnerships registered in German territory, joint-stock companies, and other commercial companies were all subject to the two preceding sections.
translations.idiomatic: Ordinary partnerships, limited partnerships, joint-stock companies, and other German commercial forms were all subject to the preceding rules.

sentences.zh: 茲並訂明，本約告成之時，凡曾經呈控公堂而由公堂判定，及不予准理之案，均與是款無涉。

translations.literal: It was further stipulated that cases already decided or dismissed by courts when this treaty was concluded were not affected by this article.
translations.idiomatic: Cases already decided or dismissed when the treaty was signed were excluded.

sentences.zh: 第八款，開埠：凡各國代其本國人民船舶索開之口岸地方，德國商人與德國保護之人民，及德國船舶，均可共用此益。

translations.literal: Article 8, Opening ports: wherever powers obtained ports for their nationals' ships, German merchants, protected persons, and German vessels might share the same benefit.
translations.idiomatic: Article 8, Ports: Germans, protected persons, and German ships shared any port opened for another power's nationals.

sentences.zh: 第九款，行船：中國本知宜昌至重慶一帶水道宜加整頓，以便輪船行駛，所以彼此訂定，未能整頓以前，應准輪船業主聽候海關核准，自行出資安設拖拉過灘利便之件。

translations.literal: Article 9, Navigation: China recognized that the Yichang–Chongqing waterway should be improved for steam navigation; until improvement, steamboat owners might, with customs approval, install towing appliances at their own expense.
translations.idiomatic: Article 9, Navigation: until the Yichang–Chongqing route was improved, steamboat owners might install towing gear at their own expense with customs approval.

sentences.zh: 其所安設利便之件，無論民船、輪船，均須遵照海關與創辦利便之人商議後所定章程辦理。

translations.literal: Such appliances, whether for native or steam vessels, must follow regulations agreed between customs and the installer.
translations.idiomatic: All vessels had to follow regulations agreed between customs and the installer.

sentences.zh: 其標示記號之台塔及指示水槽之標記，由海關酌度何地相宜備設。

translations.literal: Signal towers and channel markers were to be placed where customs deemed appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: Customs would place signal towers and channel markers where appropriate.

sentences.zh: 將來整頓水道，及利於行船而無害于地方百姓，且不費中國國家之款，中國不宜拒阻。

translations.literal: Future waterway improvements that aided navigation without harming local people and without cost to the Chinese state should not be refused by China.
translations.idiomatic: China should not refuse future improvements that aided navigation, harmed no locals, and cost the state nothing.

sentences.zh: 第十款，內港行船章程：前已特准在通商口岸行駛貿易，因是年七月二十八號及九月先後所訂此項章程間有未便，是以彼此訂明，從新修改。

translations.literal: Article 10, Inland navigation regulations: trade by steamers in treaty ports had been specially permitted; because regulations of July 28 and September of that year proved inconvenient, both sides agreed to revise them.
translations.idiomatic: Article 10, Inland navigation: regulations of July 28 and September were revised as inconvenient.

sentences.zh: 第十一款，圜法：中國允原設法定為合例之國幣，將來德國商人及德國保護人民並中國人民，應遵照以完納各項稅課及付一切用款。

translations.literal: Article 11, Currency: China agreed that the legally established national currency would be used by German merchants, protected persons, and Chinese for all tax payments and expenses.
translations.idiomatic: Article 11, Currency: all parties would use China's legal national currency for taxes and payments.

sentences.zh: 第十二款，禁令：一千八百八十一年九月二號中德條約附載之通商章程第五款第三節內開，「凡米穀等糧，德商欲運往中國通商別口，照銅錢一律辦理」等因，茲彼此應允，若在某處，無論因何事故，如有饑荒之虞，中國政府先於二十一日前出示禁止米穀等糧由該處出口，各商自當遵辦。

translations.literal: Article 12, Prohibitions: under Section 3 of Article 5 of the commercial regulations annexed to the Sino-German treaty of September 2, 1881, regarding grain transport between treaty ports, both sides agreed that if famine was feared anywhere, China might prohibit grain export from that place with twenty-one days' notice, and merchants must comply.
translations.idiomatic: Article 12, Prohibitions: if famine threatened, China might ban grain export with twenty-one days' notice, and merchants must comply.

sentences.zh: 倘船隻為專租載運穀米，若在奉禁期前，或甫屆禁期到埠尚未裝完已買定之米穀者，仍可准於禁期七日內一律裝完出口。

translations.literal: If a vessel chartered solely for grain arrived before the ban or at its start with unfinished purchased grain, loading might still be completed and export allowed within seven days of the ban.
translations.idiomatic: Grain ships that arrived before or at the ban with unfinished cargo might complete loading within seven days.

sentences.zh: 惟米穀禁期之內，應於示內聲明漕米、軍米有無出口。

translations.literal: During the grain ban, proclamations must state whether tribute grain and military grain would be exported.
translations.idiomatic: Proclamations had to state whether tribute and military grain would be exported.

sentences.zh: 如運出口者，應於海關冊簿詳細登記進出若干，其餘他項米穀，中國政府必須設法一概不准轉運出口。

translations.literal: If exported, amounts must be registered in detail at customs; all other grain must be prevented from export by every means.
translations.idiomatic: Exported amounts were to be registered at customs; all other grain export was to be stopped.

sentences.zh: 其禁止米穀以及禁期內應運之漕米、軍米數目，各告示均須由中國政府頒發，以期共見。

translations.literal: Prohibitions on grain and amounts of tribute and military grain permitted during the ban must be issued by the Chinese government for public notice.
translations.idiomatic: All bans and permitted tribute and military grain amounts were to be publicly proclaimed by the government.

sentences.zh: 二十一日之期限，必須自京報登刊之日起計。

translations.literal: The twenty-one-day period must be counted from publication in the Peking Gazette.
translations.idiomatic: The twenty-one-day notice period ran from publication in the Peking Gazette.

sentences.zh: 限滿弛禁之告示，亦須載於京報，使眾得聞。

translations.literal: Notices lifting the ban when the term expired must also appear in the Peking Gazette for public knowledge.
translations.idiomatic: Lifting of the ban was also to be published in the Peking Gazette.

sentences.zh: 至米穀等糧，仍不准運出外國。

translations.literal: Grain might still not be exported to foreign countries.
translations.idiomatic: Grain export to foreign countries remained prohibited.

sentences.zh: 第十三款，中、德兩國於本約以前所立各條約，除因立本約有所更改外，均仍舊施行。

translations.literal: Article 13: all prior Sino-German treaties remained in force except where changed by this treaty.
translations.idiomatic: Article 13: prior treaties remained in force except as changed here.

sentences.zh: 嗣後如有文詞辯論之處，應以德文作為正義。

translations.literal: Henceforth, in any dispute over wording, the German text would be authoritative.
translations.idiomatic: The German text would prevail in any dispute over wording.

sentences.zh: 是年與德訂互寄郵件暫行章程。

translations.literal: That year provisional regulations for mutual postal exchange with Germany were concluded.
translations.idiomatic: That year China and Germany agreed provisional postal exchange regulations.

sentences.zh: 訂後，德使穆默牒總稅務司聲明三事：一，高密所設之德國郵局，應俟德軍撤屯方能裁撤；

translations.literal: After signing, Minister Mumm notified the Inspector General of three points: first, the German post office at Gaomi could be abolished only after German troops withdrew;
translations.idiomatic: After signing, Mumm notified Hart of three points: first, the Gaomi German post office would close only after troop withdrawal;

sentences.zh: 二，山東一帶涉及德人之處，所有華局酌用德文人員；

translations.literal: second, in Shandong areas involving Germans, Chinese post offices might employ German staff as appropriate;
translations.idiomatic: second, Chinese post offices in German-related areas in Shandong might employ Germans;

sentences.zh: 三，山東鐵路允中國郵政得有任藉此路運送郵袋之權。

translations.literal: third, the Shandong railway permitted Chinese post to use it freely for mail bags.
translations.idiomatic: third, Chinese mail might use the Shandong railway freely.

sentences.zh: 總稅務司得牒，均照允，惟酌用德文人員，謂須視有無人才，方能照辦。

translations.literal: The Inspector General received the note and agreed to all, but on employing Germans said it depended on whether suitable personnel were available.
translations.idiomatic: Hart agreed to all, but said German staff would be employed only if suitable candidates were found.

sentences.zh: 會德人收中國商報，電政大臣袁世凱請外務部嚴禁。

translations.literal: When Germans began collecting Chinese commercial telegrams, Telegraph Director Yuan Shikai asked the Foreign Ministry to forbid it strictly.
translations.idiomatic: When Germans began intercepting commercial telegrams, Yuan Shikai asked the Foreign Ministry to forbid it.

sentences.zh: 既而德允停收商報，並允中國電報局設在山東鐵路車站。

translations.literal: Germany then agreed to stop collecting commercial telegrams and permitted Chinese telegraph offices at Shandong railway stations.
translations.idiomatic: Germany then stopped intercepting commercial telegrams and allowed Chinese telegraph offices at railway stations.

sentences.zh: 已，復又請由煙臺至上海線及北京至大沽行軍陸線求借用，拒之。

translations.literal: Thereafter they again requested use of the Yantai–Shanghai line and the Beijing–Dagu military land line; this was refused.
translations.idiomatic: They then asked to use the Yantai–Shanghai and Beijing–Dagu military lines; China refused.

sentences.zh: 又拒德商禮和洋行私購湖南礦產。

translations.literal: China also refused the German firm Carlowitz & Co.'s private purchase of Hunan mineral rights.
translations.idiomatic: China also refused Carlowitz & Co.'s private purchase of Hunan mining rights.

sentences.zh: 又德定濟南、漢口、江寧等處領事兼管各處交涉事宜，照會外務部，略謂「山東省除登州府仍歸煙臺本國領事辦理本國交涉事宜，並膠澳租地歸駐青島德國總督外，其餘所有東省本國交涉事，統歸駐濟南商辦事件委員經理。

translations.literal: Germany also fixed consular jurisdictions at Jinan, Hankou, Jiangning, and elsewhere, notifying the Foreign Ministry in substance: "In Shandong, except Dengzhou still handled by the Yantai consul and the Jiaozhou lease by the governor at Qingdao, all other German affairs in the province are managed by the commercial commissioner at Jinan."
translations.idiomatic: Germany notified the Foreign Ministry that except Dengzhou (Yantai consul) and the Jiaozhou lease (Qingdao governor), all Shandong German affairs fell under the Jinan commercial commissioner.

sentences.zh: 其煙臺本國領事官，僅有登州府本國交涉事歸其經理。

translations.literal: The Yantai consul handled only German affairs in Dengzhou prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Yantai consul handled only Dengzhou.

sentences.zh: 又定明漢口本國領事應辦本國交涉事宜，系湖南、陝西、甘肅三省。

translations.literal: It was further fixed that the Hankou consul handled German affairs in Hunan, Shaanxi, and Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: The Hankou consul covered Hunan, Shaanxi, and Gansu.

sentences.zh: 湖北除歸宜昌領事辦理各府外，並江西省之袁州府等處，悉歸漢口本國領事經理。

translations.literal: In Hubei, except prefectures under the Yichang consul, and Yuanzhou in Jiangxi, all fell under the Hankou consul.
translations.idiomatic: In Hubei, except Yichang's prefectures, and Yuanzhou in Jiangxi, all fell under Hankou.

sentences.zh: 至駐江甯府領事應辦本國交涉事宜，系安徽、江西二省。

translations.literal: The consul at Jiangning handled German affairs in Anhui and Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: The Jiangning consul covered Anhui and Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 除歸漢口領事之袁州府外，又江蘇省之江寧府等處」云云。

translations.literal: Apart from Yuanzhou under Hankou, and Jiangning prefecture and other places in Jiangsu," and so on.
translations.idiomatic: Apart from Yuanzhou (Hankou) and Jiangning and other places in Jiangsu."

sentences.zh: 是年德福親王來京覲見。

translations.literal: That year Prince Frederick of Germany came to the capital for an audience.
translations.idiomatic: That year Prince Frederick of Germany was received in audience in Beijing.

sentences.zh: 德皇子婚禮，命出使德國大臣廕昌往賀，並派學生往柏林留學。

translations.literal: For the German crown prince's wedding, Envoy Yin Chang was sent to congratulate, and students were dispatched to study in Berlin.
translations.idiomatic: Yin Chang was sent to congratulate the crown prince's wedding, and students were sent to study in Berlin.

sentences.zh: 三十二年二月，德人始在津關請領聯單，赴新疆採買土貨。

translations.literal: In the second month of the thirty-second year, Germans first applied at Tianjin customs for transit certificates to go to Xinjiang to purchase native goods.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the thirty-second year, Germans first obtained transit papers at Tianjin customs to buy native goods in Xinjiang.

sentences.zh: 三月，德使穆默牒中國，請派員往柏林商議無線電會約章，政府約二次開會再行核辦。

translations.literal: In the third month, Minister Mumm asked China to send delegates to Berlin to negotiate the wireless telegraph convention; the government deferred decision until a second meeting.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, Mumm asked China to send delegates to Berlin for wireless telegraph talks; the government deferred until a second meeting.

sentences.zh: 閏四月，德交還天津馬隊營盤等處房地，並砲隊、機器槍隊、屠牲場、養病院各房屋。

translations.literal: In the intercalary fourth month, Germany returned the Tianjin cavalry camp and other properties, and buildings of the artillery, machine-gun, slaughterhouse, and hospital units.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary fourth month, Germany returned the Tianjin cavalry camp and buildings of the artillery, machine-gun, slaughterhouse, and hospital units.

sentences.zh: 是月，德在營口改設正領事。

translations.literal: That month Germany established a full consul at Yingkou.
translations.idiomatic: That month Germany established a full consulate at Yingkou.

sentences.zh: 德使穆默回國，署使葛爾士牒中國，復以通商口岸限制洋人置地辦法與條約不符，請除限制，並謂德人地產收回公用，可會商。

translations.literal: Minister Mumm returned home; Acting Envoy Giers sent a note to China again stating that restrictions on foreign land purchase in treaty ports did not accord with treaties and asking that they be removed, and also that German property taken for public use might be negotiated.
translations.idiomatic: After Mumm left, Acting Envoy Giers protested that treaty-port land restrictions violated treaties and asked their removal, and said German property taken for public use could be negotiated.

sentences.zh: 六月，德人李卜克在北京設立學堂，德使請中國攤出經費，不許。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, the German Ribbentrop established a school in Beijing; the German envoy asked China to contribute funds; this was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Ribbentrop opened a school in Beijing; the German minister asked China to fund it, but was refused.

sentences.zh: 三十三年四月，以孫寶琦為出使德國大臣，遞國書。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the thirty-third year, Sun Baoqi was appointed envoy to Germany and presented credentials.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the thirty-third year, Sun Baoqi was appointed envoy to Germany and presented credentials.

sentences.zh: 是月，外務部咨改訂青島租界製成貨物徵稅新章。

translations.literal: That month the Foreign Ministry consulted on revising new regulations for taxing manufactured goods in the Qingdao concession.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Foreign Ministry revised tax regulations on manufactured goods in the Qingdao concession.

sentences.zh: 初，青島設關徵稅一事，已於與德使海靖議定辦法，嗣於三十一年又與德使穆默修改，其大意即系德國允在海邊劃一地界，作為停泊船隻、起下貨物之定所，凡出口貨在未下船以前，即完出口稅，進口貨除軍用各物暨租地內所用機器並建修物料免稅外，其餘百貨，於起岸後未出新定之界以前，即完進口稅，關員在彼辦理，德國相助無阻。

translations.literal: Initially, customs at Qingdao had been arranged with Minister Heinze and revised in the thirty-first year with Minister Mumm: Germany permitted a coastal zone for anchorage and cargo handling; export duties were paid before goods left ship; imports except military goods, machinery, and building materials in the lease were taxed after landing but before leaving the zone; Chinese customs officers worked there with German cooperation.
translations.idiomatic: Qingdao customs had been arranged with Heinze and revised with Mumm in the thirty-first year: a coastal zone for cargo handling; export tax before shipment; import tax after landing except military goods, machinery, and building materials; Chinese customs with German cooperation.

sentences.zh: 又由中國允每於結底，將本結所收進口稅提出二成，撥交青島德國官憲應用。

translations.literal: China also agreed that at each settlement twenty percent of import duties collected would be allocated to the German authorities at Qingdao.
translations.idiomatic: China also agreed to give twenty percent of import duties at each settlement to the German authorities at Qingdao.

sentences.zh: 既因續訂章程，德租界內製成貨物徵稅一條，語義未盡，因與德使葛爾士再訂徵稅新章。

translations.literal: Because the supplementary regulations left the article on taxing manufactured goods in the German concession unclear, new tax regulations were again concluded with Acting Envoy Giers.
translations.idiomatic: Because the tax article on manufactured goods in the concession was unclear, new regulations were concluded with Giers.

sentences.zh: 初，中國欲修天津至鎮江鐵路，與德、英借款，已立合同。

translations.literal: Initially China wished to build a railway from Tianjin to Zhenjiang and had concluded a loan contract with Germany and Britain.
translations.idiomatic: China had contracted a German–British loan to build the Tianjin–Zhenjiang railway.

sentences.zh: 至是，直隸、江蘇、山東三省京官請攬歸自修，命張之洞、袁世凱商辦，議改合同，德、英執不允。

translations.literal: At this point Beijing officials from Zhili, Jiangsu, and Shandong asked to build it themselves; Zhang Zhidong and Yuan Shikai were ordered to negotiate contract changes; Germany and Britain refused.
translations.idiomatic: Beijing officials from Zhili, Jiangsu, and Shandong asked to build it themselves; Zhang Zhidong and Yuan Shikai were told to renegotiate, but Germany and Britain refused.

sentences.zh: 乃又增派外務部右侍郎梁敦彥會同張之洞等籌議。

translations.literal: Vice Minister of Foreign Affairs Liang Dunyan was added to join Zhang Zhidong and others in deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Minister Liang Dunyan was added to join Zhang Zhidong in the talks.

sentences.zh: 初，津鎮鐵路借款之開議也，德使增索接造支路二道，一由德州至正定，一由兗州至開封，為原議所無，不允。

translations.literal: When the Tianjin–Zhenjiang railway loan was first discussed, the German envoy additionally demanded two branch lines—not in the original plan—from Dezhou to Zhengding and from Yanzhou to Kaifeng; this was refused.
translations.idiomatic: At first Germany demanded two extra branch lines—from Dezhou to Zhengding and Yanzhou to Kaifeng—not in the original plan; China refused.

sentences.zh: 德使乃始變計：一，允由膠澳至沂州府一段，仍作為津鎮支路，歸入官路；

translations.literal: The German envoy then changed course: first, the section from Jiaozhou Bay to Yizhou prefecture would remain a Tianjin–Zhenjiang branch under state control;
translations.idiomatic: Germany then shifted: first, the Jiaozhou Bay–Yizhou section would count as a state-controlled branch of the main line;

sentences.zh: 二，允由濟南府往山東界之一道，包入津鎮官路。

translations.literal: second, the line from Jinan prefecture to the Shandong border would be included in the state railway.
translations.idiomatic: second, the Jinan–Shandong border line would be included in the state railway.

sentences.zh: 中國亦允由德州至正定府及由兗州府或幹路中之他處過濟寧州至開封府兩支路，於十五年內由中國自行籌辦，並聲明儻用洋款，須向德華公司商借。

translations.literal: China also agreed that the two branches from Dezhou to Zhengding and from Yanzhou or elsewhere on the main line via Jining to Kaifeng would be built by China within fifteen years, and declared that if foreign loans were used, they must be borrowed from the Sino-German company.
translations.idiomatic: China agreed to build the Dezhou–Zhengding and Yanzhou–Kaifeng branches within fifteen years, borrowing from the Sino-German company if foreign funds were needed.

sentences.zh: 至是遂由梁敦彥與德、英銀行等改訂借款合同二十四款，名為中國國家天津浦口鐵路五釐利息借款。

translations.literal: At this point Liang Dunyan and the German and British banks revised the loan contract in twenty-four articles, titled the Chinese Imperial Tianjin–Pukou Railway Five Percent Loan.
translations.idiomatic: Liang Dunyan and the German and British banks then signed a revised twenty-four-article loan, the Tianjin–Pukou Railway Five Percent Loan.

sentences.zh: 既定議，即由外務部牒德使，聲明膠沂、濟東路線應作為津鎮支路，其由德州至正定、兗州至開封支路，均由中國自造。

translations.literal: Once agreed, the Foreign Ministry notified the German envoy that the Jiaozhou–Yizhou and east-of-Jinan lines were branches of the main railway, while the Dezhou–Zhengding and Yanzhou–Kaifeng branches would be built by China.
translations.idiomatic: The Foreign Ministry then told the German minister that the Jiaozhou–Yizhou and east-of-Jinan lines were main-line branches, while Dezhou–Zhengding and Yanzhou–Kaifeng would be built by China.

sentences.zh: 已，復與德議訂電政合同，即青、煙、滬水線交接辦法，並購回京沽軍線條款，及山東鐵路附設電線辦法章程共十四款。

translations.literal: Thereafter a telegraph contract with Germany was concluded—fourteen articles on the Qingdao–Yantai–Shanghai cable handover, repurchase of the Beijing–Dagu military line, and telegraph wires along the Shandong railway.
translations.idiomatic: China then signed a fourteen-article telegraph agreement covering the Qingdao–Yantai–Shanghai cable, repurchase of the Beijing–Dagu military line, and wires along the Shandong railway.

sentences.zh: 是年，德柏林賽衛生民學會及萬國玩耍排列館請中國派員入會，許之。

translations.literal: That year the Berlin Hygiene Exhibition and the Universal Games invited China to send delegates; this was permitted.
translations.idiomatic: That year China agreed to send delegates to the Berlin Hygiene Exhibition and the Universal Games.

sentences.zh: 三年，山東巡撫孫寶琦與德訂收回各路礦權合同。

translations.literal: In the third year, Shandong governor Sun Baoqi concluded with Germany a contract to recover mining rights on various routes.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, Governor Sun Baoqi concluded a contract with Germany to recover mining rights.

sentences.zh: 初，德商礦務公司照約在坊子、馬莊開礦，屢禁華人在附近開礦，爭執有年。

translations.literal: Initially the German mining company opened mines at Fangzi and Mazhuang under treaty and repeatedly barred Chinese from mining nearby; disputes lasted years.
translations.idiomatic: The German mining company had long barred Chinese mining near Fangzi and Mazhuang despite years of dispute.

sentences.zh: 迨津浦借款合同簽定，又要索膠沂、津浦路內礦權，並請封禁大汶口華礦，政府不許。

translations.literal: After the Tianjin–Pukou loan was signed, Germany again demanded mining rights along the Jiaozhou–Yizhou and Tianjin–Pukou lines and asked to ban Chinese mines at Dawenkou; the government refused.
translations.idiomatic: After the Tianjin–Pukou loan, Germany demanded mining rights along those lines and a ban on Chinese mines at Dawenkou; the government refused.

sentences.zh: 於是德使照會始有劃清礦權之語。

translations.literal: The German envoy's note then spoke of demarcating mining rights.
translations.idiomatic: The German minister's note then proposed demarcating mining rights.

sentences.zh: 孫寶琦即派道員蕭應椿等與德公司總辦畢象賢、領事貝斯商議收回，而畢象賢等則以中國欲收回三路礦權，須以相當之利益互換，否則不允。

translations.literal: Sun Baoqi sent Intendant Xiao Yingchun and others to negotiate recovery with company manager Bi Xiangxian and Consul Beth, but Bi and others said China must offer equivalent benefits in exchange for recovering the three-route mining rights, or they would not agree.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Baoqi sent Xiao Yingchun to negotiate with Bi Xiangxian and Consul Beth, but they demanded equivalent compensation for the three mining zones.

sentences.zh: 初議淄、博礦界，公司第一次繪送礦界圖，系淄川全境，並毗連博山，蕭應椿等以淄、博窮黎向以採煤為衣食，若兩境全為公司所有，勢必至華民無以為生，因議博境全留，淄境各半，以天臺、昆侖兩山為界，山北歸公司，山南歸華人，公司未允。

translations.literal: They first discussed the Zichuan–Boshan boundary; the company's map covered all Zichuan and adjoining Boshan; Xiao argued that the poor of Zibo lived by coal mining and if both districts went to the company Chinese would have no livelihood, proposing all of Boshan for Chinese and half of Zichuan divided by Tiantai and Kunlun mountains—north to the company, south to Chinese; the company refused.
translations.idiomatic: On the Zichuan–Boshan boundary, the company claimed all Zichuan and Boshan; Xiao argued locals lived by coal and proposed all Boshan for Chinese and half of Zichuan split by Tiantai and Kunlun mountains; the company refused.

sentences.zh: 蕭應椿因親赴淄川會畢象賢查勘，並邀集紳董礦商，旋議定淄川東南境由大奎山起斜經龍口鎮西北至淄川東境為界，界南礦產歸華商辦理，博山亦全讓還，次議淄川華礦，次議濰縣礦界，次議金嶺鎮鐵礦，次議償給勘礦購地費。

translations.literal: Xiao went in person to Zichuan to survey with Bi Xiangxian and convened gentry and miners; they then fixed the southeast boundary from Daikui Mountain slanting via Longkou to Zichuan's east border—minerals south to Chinese merchants, all Boshan returned—then discussed Chinese mines in Zichuan, Weixian boundaries, Jinlingzhen iron mines, and compensation for survey and land purchase.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao surveyed with Bi in Zichuan and fixed a boundary from Daikui Mountain via Longkou—minerals south to Chinese, all Boshan returned—then settled Zichuan Chinese mines, Weixian, Jinlingzhen iron, and compensation.

sentences.zh: 自是公司已成之膠濟鐵路，未成之津浦鐵路，甫勘之膠沂路，及曹州教案條約許與公司之三十里礦權，均允取消。

translations.literal: Thereupon the company's rights along the completed Jiaoji Railway, the unbuilt Tianjin–Pukou line, the newly surveyed Jiaozhou–Yizhou route, and the thirty-li mining zone granted under the Caozhou missionary treaty were all cancelled.
translations.idiomatic: The company then gave up mining rights along the Jiaoji line, the planned Tianjin–Pukou line, the Jiaozhou–Yizhou route, and the thirty-li zone from the Caozhou treaty.
